Here are some of the latest news highlights about **NVIDIA** as of **June 2024**:

### **1. NVIDIA Surpasses Microsoft & Apple to Become World’s Most Valuable Company**
   - **Date:** June 18, 2024
   - **Details:** NVIDIA briefly overtook **Microsoft** and **Apple** to become the **world’s most valuable company** (market cap ~$3.34 trillion) due to surging demand for its AI chips.
   - **Source:** [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/), [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/)

### **2. NVIDIA’s Next-Gen AI Chips: **Rubin (2026) & Blackwell Ultra (2025)**
   - **Date:** June 2024 (Computex 2024)
   - **Details:**
     - **Blackwell Ultra (B100)** – Expected in **2025**, an upgraded version of the **B200** with better performance.
     - **Rubin (R100)** – A **2026** successor to Blackwell, featuring **HBM4 memory** and a new **NVLink 6** interconnect.
   - **Source:** [NVIDIA Blog](https://blogs.nvidia.com/), [Tom’s Hardware](https://www.tomshardware.com/)

### **3. NVIDIA’s AI-Powered **Omniverse Cloud APIs** for Enterprises**
   - **Date:** June 2024
   - **Details:** NVIDIA launched **Omniverse Cloud APIs** to help developers build **AI-powered 3D workflows** for digital twins, robotics, and industrial automation.
   - **Source:** [NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/)

### **4. NVIDIA & **Microsoft’s AI Supercomputer** (Stargate Project)**
   - **Date:** June 2024 (Updates)
   - **Details:** Microsoft is reportedly building a **$100B AI supercomputer** (codenamed **Stargate**) using **NVIDIA’s next-gen GPUs**, expected by **2028**.
   - **Source:** [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/)

### **5. NVIDIA’s **AI-Powered Robotics** (Project GR00T & Isaac Lab)**
   - **Date:** June 2024
   - **Details:** NVIDIA announced **GR00T**, a **general-purpose AI model for humanoid robots**, and **Isaac Lab**, a simulation platform for training robots.
   - **Source:** [NVIDIA Developer Blog](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/)

### **6. NVIDIA’s **Stock Split (10-for-1) & Record Highs**
   - **Date:** June 7, 2024
   - **Details:** NVIDIA completed a **10-for-1 stock split**, making shares more accessible to retail investors. The stock hit **$1,200+ per share** post-split.
   - **Source:** [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/)

### **7. NVIDIA’s **AI-Powered Healthcare** (BioNeMo & MONAI Cloud)**
   - **Date:** June 2024
   - **Details:** NVIDIA expanded its **BioNeMo** platform for **drug discovery** and **MONAI Cloud** for **medical imaging AI**.
   - **Source:** [NVIDIA Healthcare](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/healthcare/)

### **8. NVIDIA’s **Partnership with **Tesla** for AI & Robotaxis**
   - **Date:** June 2024 (Rumors)
   - **Details:** Reports suggest **Tesla** may use **NVIDIA’s DRIVE Thor** chips for its **next-gen robotaxis** (replacing in-house Dojo).
   - **Source:** [Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/)

---
### **Where to Find More Updates?**
- **Official NVIDIA News:** [NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/)
- **Stock & Financials:** [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA/)
- **Tech & AI News:** [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/), [Tom’s Hardware](https://www.tomshardware.com/)
